status: Validated against T3 Code's source, docs, agent instructions and tool-use evaluation cases at pingdotgg/t3code da04ebc and against the running desktop build 0.1.6-nightly.20261029.3892; one Codex Sol and Claude Opus review round; matched baseline and candidate decision probes on both hosts.
request: Improve pr-followup with t3dotgg/tstack's babysit-pr, adopting T3 Code guidance on how the agent waits for new PR comments and similar events.

changes.change: New T3 Code subsection: watch_pull_request armed right after the final snapshot, the remaining-checks wake, the events the watch never reports (late-starting checks, threads resolved without a comment, merge, base advancement or BEHIND, another actor's ready transition, the gh user's own comments), unwatch before any handback, re-arm from a fresh snapshot, and the comment-only stop as the loop guard. Wakes that change nothing end without a message; gh run watch and gh pr checks --watch are named as watch replacements to avoid.

Pointer to the observation reference before arming, keeping, re-arming or stopping a watch; delegated children never arm a watch and return URL, head SHA and pending state; Check scope does not register the PR and Feedback and Drive register it only when not yet registered; reports are given on handbacks and turns that changed something; one rule stops the host watch, including host handback rules.
REST fallback, including the pull request endpoint, when the GraphQL rate limit is exhausted.
New idea sources tstack-babysit-pr (1085050) and t3code-pr-watch (da04ebc) with their ideas and declined features.
A delegated child never arms the watch and returns the waiting state to its parent.
pr-followup feature line for quiet wakes and the T3 Code watch.
